verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks {2, 6, 10, 14}, builds `kept = [0,1,3,4,5,7,8,9,11,12,13,15]` and maps them to 0..11 in original order, matching the required renumbering exactly; renaming into a fresh dict avoids any collision hazard, and only the block index changes while values, shapes and dtypes are passed through untouched. Non-block tensors (`model.embed_tokens.weight`, `lm_head.weight`) fall through the `fullmatch is None` branch unchanged. Both assertions — the surviving layer index set equalling `{0..11}` (which also rules out any block 12–15 remaining) and the 86-tensor count — run before `mkdir`/`save_file`, so a failure aborts with a non-zero exit and writes no output, as the "Required checks" clause demands. The output is a single `out/T1/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
